meta.title: Telemetrio MCP — Build a Telegram Channel Shortlist in Claude or ChatGPT
meta.description: Describe a country and topic in Claude or ChatGPT and get matching Telegram channels from Telemetrio’s database. Refine the list in the same conversation.

hero.eyebrow: Telemetrio MCP · For Claude and ChatGPT
hero.headline: Your next Telegram shortlist starts with one sentence
hero.lead: Tell Claude or ChatGPT which country and topic you need. Telemetrio finds matching channels in its database, and you refine the list in the same conversation.
hero.microcopy: Telemetrio data, inside your AI assistant.

builder.title: Write your first search
builder.intro: Pick the details. We’ll turn them into a prompt you can send after connecting.
builder.previewNote: Fictional channels showing the result format. Real results come from Telemetrio’s database and include a link for each channel.

refine.heading: Change the criteria without starting over
refine.lead: Each follow-up adjusts the search. Step through an example conversation and watch the shortlist update.

anatomy.heading: What a good first prompt includes
anatomy.lead: You don’t need special syntax. Four details help your assistant return a useful list.

parts.text: that I can research for potential advertising placements
Put them in a table with a link to each channel.

category.label: Category
category.text: The topic of the channels you want.

geography.label: Geography
geography.text: The country the channels are classified under in Telemetrio.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.text: Why you’re searching, so the assistant can organize the results.

format.label: Format
format.text: A list or a table, and which columns to include.

items.title: Marketers and advertisers
items.text: Find channels to evaluate for your next campaign.

items.title: Agencies
items.text: Prepare a first channel shortlist for a client.

items.title: Channel owners
items.text: See which channels share your category and country.

items.title: Analysts and businesses
items.text: Map channels in a market by country and category.

scope.heading: What Telemetrio MCP does — and what it doesn’t
does: Search by category, or combine both
Let you refine the results through conversation
doesnt: Tell you where every subscriber lives — geography is the channel’s classification in Telemetrio
Return channels that aren’t in Telemetrio’s database

connect.heading: Connect your assistant
connect.lead: Claude and ChatGPT are set up differently. Each card has the steps for that assistant.

final.heading: One sentence away from your first shortlist
final.text: Connect Telemetrio to Claude or ChatGPT, then start with a country and a topic.
